- *A page called Reviews that shows reviews is counted.* A business whose reviews page shows signed
  quotes from its customers was told it had no customer reviews. That page's only heading was its own
  name, which Docket did not read as a label. A page named Reviews or Testimonials now counts when it
  shows a quoted review, a star rating or two signed reviews.
- *Sites built with Kukui are named correctly.* Kukui, a website platform for auto repair shops, showed
  as no platform at all.

99 checks across 13 areas.
